resumeText:
Sneha Kulkarni | Nagpur | sneha.kulkarni@example.com

EDUCATION
B.Tech Electrical Engineering, Vidarbha Institute of Technology, Nagpur, 2026, CGPA 8.1

INTERNSHIP
Summer Intern, Wardha Power Transmission Pvt Ltd, 220/33 kV substation, Jun - Jul 2025
- Studied the single line diagram of the 220/33 kV substation and traced each bay on site.
- Assisted the testing team with insulation resistance tests on two 33 kV breakers.
- Noted transformer, CT and PT nameplate ratings for the substation equipment register.
- Recorded daily test readings in an Excel tracker for the commissioning engineer.

PROJECTS
- Final year: load calculation and cable sizing for a 500 kW college hostel block, with voltage drop checks.
- Mini project: speed control of a 3-phase induction motor using a VFD in the machines lab.

SKILLS
AutoCAD Electrical, MATLAB, MS Excel, electrical safety
